content.short: Zipsy is a SocialFi platform on TON that allows users to create, share, and monetize short-form content.
content.description: Zipsy is a dynamic social media application built on the TON blockchain that focuses on the creation and monetization of short-form digital content. It provides users with a seamless and engaging platform to share their creativity while leveraging the power of Web3 to reward engagement and high-quality contributions. Zipsy aims to empower the next generation of social creators by providing direct monetization paths and fostering a transparent social economy where value is shared fairly between creators and their audience. It is a leading platform for SocialFi innovation within the TON network.
content.meta: Create and monetize short content on Zipsy, the TON SocialFi app. Join the future of social on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
